requirements.observableRequirement: The v1.1 plan package is decision-complete, phase-scoped, hash-locked, and has a Phase 0 verifier; product implementation has not started.
Browser client imports no Node-only crypto module; commercial auth token hashing is isolated to server-only modules.
API requestId values propagate into AppRequestError and client error hydration paths.
RSC Supabase read clients do not mutate cookies; writable cookie clients remain limited to route handlers and middleware.
Forwarded host and client IP trust only configured proxy hops; untrusted x-forwarded-host and x-forwarded-for values are ignored.
Hosted sandbox cleanup runs through a single audited transaction or RPC with table inventory fingerprint validation, dry-run counts, apply counts, and zero residual demo rows.

requirements.authoritySource: Hosted sandbox defect analysis items 7 and 9
requirements.observableRequirement: RLS helper functions and default privileges revoke public and anon execute access and cross-tenant RLS tests run with zero unauthorized access.

requirements.authoritySource: Hosted sandbox defect analysis items 8 and 9
requirements.observableRequirement: Hosted Supabase backup and restore tooling never exposes DB passwords in process arguments, deletes plaintext dump files in finally blocks, verifies source and target project refs, and requires explicit restore approval independent from backup age identity.
ReleaseIdentity is deterministic, centralized, and build-bound; building the app does not modify tracked source files including app/public/sw.js.

requirements.authoritySource: Hosted sandbox defect analysis items 11, 12, 13, and 14
requirements.observableRequirement: GitHub workflows produce provenance-bound standalone artifacts, apply migrations only after fingerprint checks, and deploy to VPS by atomic release directory plus symlink switch with verified rollback.
Production edge headers disable X-Powered-By, prevent one-year caching of primary HTML, and use a bounded CSP without production unsafe-eval or wildcard HTTPS and WSS sources.

requirements.authoritySource: Hosted sandbox defect analysis items 15, 16, and 17
requirements.observableRequirement: Hosted activation executes real backup, migration, cleanup, artifact deploy, release-aware smoke, live admin/customer auth smoke, Android Chrome/PWA/TalkBack validation, and contamination-zero checks; simulated, blocked, skipped, or stale checks fail apply mode.
